visual.general_description: Two side-by-side color clinical photographs of a child's back: panel A with widespread red, papular and eroded skin and panel B with mostly uniform tan skin and faint pink marks.
visual.detailed_description: Figure of two color photographs arranged left and right, labelled (A) and (B) at the upper left of each. Panel A shows the back and shoulder of an infant with diffusely pink-red thickened-looking skin, many raised papules and nodules, a few blister-like or eroded spots and crusted areas, with a diaper at the bottom. Panel B shows the back and flank of a child with a red shirt lifted, smooth tan skin with faint scattered pink marks and a white diaper. Adult hands are visible in both panels.

panels.general_description: Color photograph of an infant's bare back and shoulder with widespread pink-red skin carrying many raised papules and a few eroded or blister-like spots.
panels.detailed_description: Color photograph taken from behind of an infant's neck, upper back, a shoulder at the right of the frame and lower back, with a diaper at the bottom edge. The skin is diffusely pink to red and looks thickened, with a grayish-brown patch across the mid upper back. Numerous scattered raised, pale-cream to pink papules and small nodules are present across the back, some with small red central marks. In the lower left of the back there are flat pale-pink blister-like or eroded areas, and along the right side of the back there are grouped red crusted or eroded spots. An adult hand holds the child at the upper left and another hand at the lower left edge. The background includes a green and yellow toy at the upper left, a white and yellow cloth and a cream fleece surface. The printed panel letter (A) is visible at the upper left.

panels.general_description: Color photograph of a child's back and flank with a red shirt lifted, showing mostly uniform tan skin with faint scattered pink marks.
panels.detailed_description: Color photograph of a child's back and side with a red and white shirt raised at the top and a white diaper at the bottom. The skin is tan to peach and looks smooth and evenly colored, with a few faint pink-red macules and one small darker red spot lower left of center. No blisters, erosions, crusts or raised nodules are visible. An adult hand holds the shirt at the left and adult fingers pull the diaper edge at the lower right. The background is dark blue at the lower left. The printed panel letter (B) is visible at the upper left.
